summary: Filing reports a secondary public offering by selling stockholders (Arrow Holdings S.à r.l. and MFA Global S.à r.l., entities controlled by TDR Capital LLP) of 7,000,000 shares of Target Hospitality Corp. common stock at $14.00 per share, with a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 1,050,000 shares. The company receives no proceeds. The offering is registered on Form S-3 and underwritten by Morgan Stanley and Deutsche Bank. This is a routine secondary sale by a major stockholder, not a transformative special situation. Watch for any price movement or future selling by TDR.
